title: Model a state and match every variant
summary: An enum models alternatives; a struct groups named fields. This board practises exhaustive matching.

declare.clue: Keyword declaring a type whose value is one of several variants

select.clue: Expression keyword selecting an arm from the current variant

finished.clue: Variant returned after the job has finished

waitingVariant.clue: Variant representing a job that has not finished

readyVariant.clue: Variant representing a job that has finished

parameterType.clue: The enum type declared above, used as the parameter type

returnType.clue: UTF-8 string slice type behind the returned shared reference

waitingArm.clue: Pattern variant whose arm returns the string "waiting"

assertion.clue: Macro that checks whether two expressions compare equal
